title: The Portrait of the Undercroft
author: Xanthe Galloway
blurb: Wren Okonkwo, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
